title: Derived pullback and tensor preserve quasi-coherence on spaces
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], and work with algebraic spaces over $S$ and their small etale structure sheaves [def-trf-algebraic-space], in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. Use the unbounded module derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], the canonical tensor pullback and direct image [def-trf-space-etale-module-functors], their total derived functors computed by K-flat resolutions with flat terms and K-injective resolutions, and K-flat derived tensor product. Write $D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_Z)$ for objects with quasi-coherent cohomology [def-trf-space-quasi-coherent-module]. For every morphism $a:Z'\to Z$ of algebraic spaces, $La^*$ sends $D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_Z)$ into $D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_{Z'})$. For every algebraic space $Z$ and every $K,L\in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_Z)$ one has $K\otimes_{\mathcal O_Z}^{\mathbf L}L\in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_Z)$. No boundedness, flatness, quasi-compactness or quasi-separatedness assumption is imposed.

proof.text: Apply the pullback clause of [lem-sfb-space-derived-etale-chart-calculus] to the given morphism $a$. Its universally quantified morphism $u$ is instantiated by $a$, with the source and target renamed accordingly. It applies to every unbounded quasi-coherent complex and gives the first assertion.

source.place: Tag 08F4, lemma-quasi-coherence-pullback; using its already recorded general pullback clause.

proof.text: First handle tensor on a scheme $U$, on its small etale site. By [lem-sfb-scheme-derived-etale-qcoh-comparison], write any two quasi-coherent derived objects there as $\epsilon_U^*E$ and $\epsilon_U^*F$ with $E,F\in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_{U,\mathrm{Zar}})$. The scheme tensor clause of [lem-pc-derived-pullback-tensor-qcoh] puts $E\otimes^{\mathbf L}F$ in the Zariski quasi-coherent category. The same equivalence sends this object into the etale quasi-coherent category. Since $\epsilon_U^*$ is exact it equals $L\epsilon_U^*$, and [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback] identifies its image with $\epsilon_U^*E\otimes^{\mathbf L}\epsilon_U^*F$. Thus tensor preserves quasi-coherence on the small etale site of every scheme.

source.place: Tag 071Q, lemma-derived-quasi-coherent-small-etale-site; Tag 08F5, lemma-quasi-coherence-tensor-product, reduction to perfect.tex Tag 08DX; sites-cohomology.tex Tag 07A4.

proof.text: Choose a surjective etale scheme atlas $\varphi:U\to Z$ from [def-trf-algebraic-space]. By [lem-sfb-space-derived-etale-chart-calculus], its pullback is exact restriction, and $\varphi^*K,\varphi^*L$ have quasi-coherent cohomology. The canonical isomorphism of [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback] gives $\varphi^*(K\otimes^{\mathbf L}L)\cong\varphi^*K\otimes^{\mathbf L}\varphi^*L$. Step 2 makes the right side quasi-coherent. The covering criterion in [lem-sfb-space-derived-etale-chart-calculus] now implies that $K\otimes^{\mathbf L}L$ has quasi-coherent cohomology on $Z$. All cited results apply to unbounded objects and this atlas requires no finiteness or separation assumption.
